flags: The cache documents designation and expansion, but no byway construction campaign or detailed grades. The overview therefore uses the supported designation history.

Material supplies strip miles only for Rosalia, Oakesdale and Tekoa. Retained moments follow a subsequent southward itinerary, with Palouse Falls explicitly a separate excursion after Uniontown; the network has no single end-to-end drive.
Uniontown incorporation conflicts: tourism says 1879, while cache/19.txt distinguishes founding in 1879 from incorporation in 1890. Omitted incorporation date.
Waterfall height varies within cache/20.txt and differs from the tourism wording. Omitted height. Tourism flood-origin language was not applied to the ancient quartzite butte.

No current claim was dropped for lack of cache support. The supported Montgomery personality anecdote was replaced with the church construction story for a more concrete present connection. Summit-road access is not verified by a cached park-manager page.
